Bob Rickard | Robert "Bob" J M Rickard is the founder and editor of the UK magazine "Fortean Times: The Journal of Strange Phenomena", which debuted in 1973 under its original title "The News". His work continues to inspire admirers, who refer to themselves as "Forteans", and has influenced some aspects of science fiction.
